notes:
Hold read-along while you read a panel yourself.

A page often carries something worth reading rather than hearing — a status window, a sign, a panel to sit with. Until now the only control was Stop, which forgot your place. Hold parks the voice where it stands and keeps the page, the line and the highlight; Resume picks up the same line from the start, so you never lose half a sentence.

The control sits on the strip that shows what is being said, next to the words, because you reach for it while the voice is mid-sentence.

The credit on a chapter's title card no longer gets read out when the studio prints it in the other order. Solo Leveling was opening every chapter by reading its own credits aloud.

Chapters you've already read will re-read their pages once to pick this up.
